event.name: Sealed Hold
event.text: A freighter drifts dark and silent at the edge of the cluster. Its cargo hold is still sealed. Your scans show no life aboard.

choice.outcome: Your crew cut their way in and find the hold still half full. They haul across everything worth converting.
The cutting torch sets off a fuel line behind the doors. The blast throws your crew clear, but {crew} is burned before they can get back aboard.
You leave the freighter to drift. Whatever it carried can stay its own business.

choice.text: Have {crew} plug into the freighter's door controls.
choice.outcome: {crew} links into the freighter's systems and takes control of the doors. The hold opens without a spark. Your crew empty it at their leisure.

event.name: Loose Rock
event.text: The cluster's star is ringed by a slow belt of asteroids. Some of them glitter with ore worth converting into Mawjig. Mining them means flying close.

choice.text: Move in and mine the nearest asteroids.
choice.outcome: Your squad breaks up the nearest asteroids and converts the ore.
A spinning fragment clips one of your ships before its pilot can pull away. You gather what ore you can and leave the belt.
You stay clear of the belt while your Jigawatt Drives charge.

choice.text: Scan the belt for the richest rock first.
choice.outcome: Your sensors pick out a single asteroid veined with ore, drifting well away from the rest. Your squad mines it without a scratch.

event.name: One Life Sign
event.text:
A damaged shuttle hangs in the cluster, its engines dead. Its pilot hails you, weak but polite.
"Please, I've been out here for days. I can fly anything you give me if you take me with you."

choice.outcome: The pilot is as harmless as they sounded, and grateful to be somewhere warm. Once they have eaten, they ask to join your crew.
As you match course, a pirate ship powers up behind the shuttle. The pilot was only bait.
You leave the shuttle behind. Its pilot's hails follow you until you jump.

choice.text: Ask {crew} what they sense aboard the shuttle.
choice.outcome:
{crew} goes still for a moment. "One life on that shuttle. More on the ship hiding behind it."
Your scanners show nothing, but you trust {crew}.
The pirate ship drops its disguise when it sees you coming. Its crew are not ready for a fight.
You jump away before the pirates can spring their trap.

event.name: The Toll
event.text:
A pirate ship drops out of hiding as you arrive and trains its weapons on your squad.
"This cluster's ours. Pay the toll and fly on, or we take it from your wreck."

choice.outcome: The pirates count your payment twice before letting you go.
"Your funeral," the pirate captain says.

choice.text: Cloak and lead your squad out of their sensor range.
choice.outcome: You cloak and lead your squad along the edge of the cluster, out of the pirates' sensor range. By the time they stop searching, you are gone.

event.name: Torn Wing
event.text: An Azurethea explorer ship rests near one of the cluster's moons, one of its wings torn. Its crew hail you gently and say they will manage on their own.

choice.text: Offer to help with their repairs.
choice.outcome: Your crew spend hours patching the explorer's torn wing. The Azurethea thank you in their quiet way and send over what Mawjig they can spare.

choice.text: Wish them well and move on.
choice.outcome: The explorer dips its wings as you leave.
{crew} talks with them for a long time. Afterwards, the explorers offer to tend your ship as well, and a team of them works through one of your damaged systems.

event.name: Making Room
event.text: A small Tentauri ship arrives right behind you, its shields bright. Its two crew ask, quietly, that your squad move aside. They are passing through and would rather not wait.

choice.text: Move aside and let them pass.
choice.outcome: The Tentauri slip past without another word.
The Tentauri ship pushes through your formation anyway, its shields grinding against your hull. It never fires, and it is gone before you can.
{crew} and the strangers trade a few soft words. The Tentauri stay long enough to help repair one of your systems before they go on their way.

event.name: Old Wreckage
event.text: The wreckage of an old battle drifts through the cluster, cold and scattered. Some of the wrecks still carry unspent missiles. Some of those are still live.

choice.text: Send your crew to search the wrecks.
choice.outcome: Your crew find a rack of missiles still sealed in its casing and bring it home.
A missile wakes up as your crew move it. The blast wounds {crew} before the others can pull them clear.
The wreckage drifts on behind you as you leave.

choice.text: Teleport the salvage aboard from a safe distance.
choice.outcome: You lock onto the wrecks from a safe distance and teleport across everything that still looks useful.

event.name: Mecha Ground
event.text:
A Mecha patrol ship blocks your way, wide and heavily armed.
"This cluster belongs to us. Leave it, or pay to stay."

choice.outcome: The patrol takes your payment and moves aside without a word.
The patrol ship opens fire.

choice.text: Hack their sensors to make your squad look stronger.
choice.outcome: Their sensors suddenly show a squad far stronger than yours. The patrol hesitates, then decides you are not worth the risk and lets you pass.
{crew} answers them in their own blunt way. Soon the talk turns to business. The patrol decides a trade is worth more than a fight and sells you missiles from its own stores.
